 Lakers keep playing the long game with Cameron Carr after another G League assignment 
 Back to Coachella. By Svyatoslav Rovenchuk | Nov 19, 2026, 3:00 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Cameron Carr #43 of the Lakers looks on against the Heat of their 2026 California Classic Summer League game. (Photo by Thien-An Truong/Getty Images) | Photo by Thien-An Truong/Getty Images The Los Angeles Lakers have not throw Cameron Carr into the deep end during his rookie season. Why would they? For as intriguing of a talent as Carr is, the Lakers have secured a 13-3 record without really featuring him in any sort of significant fashion.
--> The Los Angeles Lakers have not throw Cameron Carr into the deep end during his rookie season. Why would they? For as intriguing of a talent as Carr is, the Lakers have secured a 13-3 record without really featuring him in any sort of significant fashion.
 That does not mean the Lakers do not care about his development. Of course they do. Their most recent decision with Carr indicates as much. Los Angeles is once again sending the talented rookie down to the G League to join the Coachella Valley Lakers.
--> That does not mean the Lakers do not care about his development. Of course they do. Their most recent decision with Carr indicates as much. Los Angeles is once again sending the talented rookie down to the G League to join the Coachella Valley Lakers.
 Their G League affiliate has a matchup on Thursday night against the Stockton Kings. Those two teams will then proceed to run it back in another head-to-head on Friday as well.
--> Their G League affiliate has a matchup on Thursday night against the Stockton Kings. Those two teams will then proceed to run it back in another head-to-head on Friday as well.
 Considering that Carr has been unable to break through in Los Angeles, Coachella Valley will give him an excellent opportunity to get some much-needed reps. JJ Redick sent him down earlier this season as well, with that exact goal in mind. Eventually, the hope would be those reps adding up and helping the Lakers rookie inch closer to being a contributor at the NBA level.
--> Considering that Carr has been unable to break through in Los Angeles, Coachella Valley will give him an excellent opportunity to get some much-needed reps. JJ Redick sent him down earlier this season as well, with that exact goal in mind. Eventually, the hope would be those reps adding up and helping the Lakers rookie inch closer to being a contributor at the NBA level.
 Lakers are finding opportunities to get Cameron Carr reps, even if it is the G League
--> Lakers are finding opportunities to get Cameron Carr reps, even if it is the G League
 Carr is a great prospect to have. His shooting stroke is fundamentally sound, his athleticism is impressive, and his wingspan gives him the chance to be a pesky defender some day. Putting all that together with the main Lakers roster just has not happened 16 games into the 2026-27 season.
--> Carr is a great prospect to have. His shooting stroke is fundamentally sound, his athleticism is impressive, and his wingspan gives him the chance to be a pesky defender some day. Putting all that together with the main Lakers roster just has not happened 16 games into the 2026-27 season.
 That should not be a cause for panic. It speaks more to the guys who are in front of Carr and how they have played in this campaign.
--> That should not be a cause for panic. It speaks more to the guys who are in front of Carr and how they have played in this campaign.
 Matisse Thybulle is thriving as a 3-and-D starter . Ziaire Williams is delivering on the upside many thought he had. Jake LaRavia is having a strong bounce-back campaign. Quentin Grimes is surging of late . The wings have some real depth in Los Angeles.
--> Matisse Thybulle is thriving as a 3-and-D starter . Ziaire Williams is delivering on the upside many thought he had. Jake LaRavia is having a strong bounce-back campaign. Quentin Grimes is surging of late . The wings have some real depth in Los Angeles.
 Perhaps if Redick really wanted to, he could find a few minutes at the end of the rotation for Carr situationally. In all fairness, the Lakers coach has given his young guy chances when the injuries were briefly piling up. Overall, though, there is a lack of readiness for the former Baylor wing this early.
--> Perhaps if Redick really wanted to, he could find a few minutes at the end of the rotation for Carr situationally. In all fairness, the Lakers coach has given his young guy chances when the injuries were briefly piling up. Overall, though, there is a lack of readiness for the former Baylor wing this early.
 That is where the G League assignment comes in. Carr can go join Coachella Valley head coach Alex Cerda. The Lakers can help their young wing get reps, practice key principles, and further prepare him for a role with the main team. 
--> That is where the G League assignment comes in. Carr can go join Coachella Valley head coach Alex Cerda. The Lakers can help their young wing get reps, practice key principles, and further prepare him for a role with the main team. 
 Cerda can then report back to Redick on how ready Carr is for minutes at the NBA level. Perhaps there will come a point in 2026-27 when the former first-round pick can be unleashed. If not, the Lakers will stay committed to long-term development with their guy.
